VBO:0200127.summary: Intelligent, friendly and strong-willed, Basset Griffon Vendéens share a scent-hunting tradition shaped by hunting on foot. The label covers two distinct breeds, Grand and Petit. The Grand is often calm and considered in company, while the Petit is lively and courageous; both retain a keen interest in trails and rough cover.
VBO:0200127.shortDescription: Grand and Petit form a French scent-hound family with independent minds, shared pack-hunting roots and a keen interest in trails.

sources.title: FCI33 — Grand Basset Griffon Vendeen entire own standard
sources.evidence: Actual entire eight-page own norm read: p2–3 furry quarry gun-hunting, late19th dElva/Dezamy selection and courageous/stubborn/fast passionate hunting; complete adult elongated balanced rough hound anatomy, notably longer muzzle than skull, very long fine low inward-folded ears beyond nose, oval dark eyes/no visible haw, straight forelegs, firm large tight feet and long high-set sabre/slightly curved full tail never on back or bent at tip. Male40–44cm.

sources.title: FCI67 — Petit Basset Griffon Vendeen entire separate standard
sources.evidence: Actual entire seven-page own norm read: rabbit gun-hunting passionate/courageous and docile but wilful character, separate proportions beyond size after historical common standard. Shorter head/muzzle/ears/tail than Grand; p2–3 confirms two distinct own norms. No Petit anatomy transferred to selected Grand representative.
